03 / THE LITTLE DETAILS

Come for the love.
Stay for the memories.

DRESS FOR THE OCCASION

Indian traditionals

Bring out your favourite sarees, lehengas, kurtas, and sherwanis. We can’t wait to see you in your festive best.

A little colour inspiration. Wear what feels like you.
When should I arrive?+

The wedding day begins at 10:00 AM. The Baraat starts at 10:30 AM, followed by the Vaarmala, Vidhi, and lunch.

Where is the celebration?+

All listed events take place at Sunol’s Casa Bella, 11984 Main Street, Sunol, CA 94586. Use “Find your way” above for directions.

What about travel and parking?+

More travel and parking details will be shared here as the day approaches. Please check back before you travel.

Is there a gift registry?+

The registry is coming soon. We’ll update this page when it’s ready. For now, we’re looking forward to celebrating with you.

Can I RSVP on this website?+

You can try the RSVP experience in this design preview. Responses are not sent to the couple yet. Please use the current wedding website for your actual RSVP.
